description: token safety, rug check, contract risk score: Fast contract / token control-plane safety verdict: verdict, riskScore 0-100 and grade A-F (both null when not determined, e.g. NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND), a one-line verdict, upgrade / owner / pause / blacklist / mint capability flags, the controller (EOA, Safe threshold, timelock delay), the indexed Pacta record when there is one, and a shareable scan URL. One pinned block; Ethereum and Base. With no arguments it checks the built-in default (ethereum 0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D405200A15b). Free: 100 calls per caller per UTC day (no key, no payment); x402 USDC on Base above quota. Shares the 100/day quota of /v1/x402/verdict; above it, call that route over HTTP with x402 ($0.02).
